extDescription.message: Finds and downloads videos embedded in web pages (direct files, HLS, DASH, yt-dlp).

ytdlpSites.message: YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook and over a thousand other sites.

ytdlpReady.message: yt-dlp $1 · saves to the Downloads folder

ytdlpDrmWarning.message: This page uses DRM: yt-dlp will refuse to download it.

emptyList.message: No video found. Start the video and open the panel again. If you just reloaded the extension, reload the page too (F5).

drmEnable.message: ⚠ Enable DRM downloads in the settings

drmBlocked.message: Protected by DRM: cannot be downloaded (can be enabled in ⚙ settings)

drmAllowed.message: Protected by DRM: the file will be encrypted and unplayable

error_drmProtected.message: Protected by DRM: cannot be downloaded

error_qualityGone.message: This quality is no longer in the manifest

error_ytdlpMissing.message: yt-dlp is not connected: run native-host/install.ps1

error_itemNotFound.message: This video is no longer on the page

optionsHlsMp4Hint.message: Rearranges the stream into an .mp4 file that plays everywhere, without re-encoding or quality loss.

optionsHlsTsHint.message: Saves the segments as they come from the server.

optionsDrmAllow.message: Allow downloading them as they are

optionsDrmHint.message: The file stays encrypted and cannot be played: only useful to test the downloader. The extension never decrypts protected content.
